daily.title: French burglar used ChatGPT to locate Canberra home with luxury goods
daily.summary: The crime began with photos of designer items posted on social media in Australia and ended with the arrest of four French men at a KFC in Sydney, fresh court documents show.

daily.title: Former childcare worker's husband avoids jail for sharing child exploitation material
daily.summary: Ronald Houghton received a suspended jail term after he was caught bragging to undercover officers about his experience abusing children in an online chat.

daily.title: Cricket Australia green lights BBL privatisation, defying power states
daily.summary: The Big Bash League is set to look like it never has before as Cricket Australia prepares to welcome private ownership to the competition.

daily.title: Court ruling clears way for 124-home Byron Shire development
daily.summary: Opponents of a controversial housing development in northern New South Wales will have a week to appeal a Federal Court ruling before excavators start digging up the site.

daily.title: Leaked text reveals Australia's $980 million commitment to Solomon Islands
daily.summary: Australia and Solomon Islands have reached an in-principle agreement over a new treaty, with a leaked text message from a high-ranking official outlining the lengths Canberra will go to to get the deal done.

daily.title: Fourth Tasmanian road fatality in a week sparks police plea
daily.summary: A fourth fatality on Tasmanian roads within a week has led police to call for drivers to be safe "every time they travel".

daily.title: A Clockwork Orange to come to stage in eerily prescient adaptation
daily.summary: A fire wiped out Belvoir St Theatre's warehouse and workshop in June. Now the company is in the rebuild phase as it launches its 2027 season.

daily.title: 'Her career's finished': Fugitive Sydney developer's daughter avoids jail
daily.summary: Ashlyn Nassif has been sentenced to a six-month community corrections order with no supervision after pleading guilty in June to publishing false misleading material to obtain advantage.

daily.title: 11 killed in avalanche on Russian peak
daily.summary: Eleven people have died in an avalanche that swept through one of the highest peaks in Russia's North Caucasus.

daily.title: Man killed after being run over by garbage truck in suburban Perth
daily.summary: A 70-year-old man has died after being run over by a garbage truck in Perth's south-eastern suburbs, with neighbours remembering as a quiet, sweet person.

daily.title: Spirit of Tasmania ferry operator to be in debt until 2052, inquiry hears
daily.summary: In the wake of the bungled Spirit of Tasmania replacement project, ferry operator TT-Line says it expects to stay in debt for an estimated 26 years.

daily.title: Radiohead announce 16 Australian shows for 2027
daily.summary: The hugely influential British band will visit Australia for the first time in 15 years in May next year.

daily.title: University regulator finds ANU breached national standards
daily.summary: The Australian National University has fallen short of national tertiary education standards and must now satisfy governance conditions to maintain its registration.

daily.title: Man with broken hip waits for hours at RFDS base before hospital admission
daily.summary: A Mount Gambier man says he spent hours waiting in agony with a broken hip at a Royal Flying Doctors Service facility and outside a hospital before he was eventually admitted for major surgery.

daily.title: V'landys accuses NRL players of 'not telling truth' on rule confusion
daily.summary: As multiple players around the NRL call out the confusion about rule changes, Peter V'landys says there is no problem.

daily.title: Mum of five repeatedly begged for medication in custody, inquest hears
daily.summary: A First Nations mother of five repeatedly begged prison officials for her medications and was discharged from hospital after a suicide attempt without a mental health review, a coronial inquest heard today. The inquest will look at whether the healthcare she received met community standards.

daily.title: $58m Aboriginal cultural centre opens at Darwin Waterfront
daily.summary: A $58 million centre showcasing the culture, history and art of Darwin's traditional owners, the Larrakia people, has opened its doors to the public, more than two decades since the idea was first developed.

daily.title: Australian navy saves Canadian sailor from sinking catamaran in Indian Ocean
daily.summary: Australian authorities executed the textbook helicopter rescue after the Canadian sailor's vessel began taking on water 1,000 kilometres south-east of Christmas Island.

daily.title: Flights cancelled, Aussies trapped as volcanic ash shuts Indonesian airports
daily.summary: An Australian trapped in Jakarta due to a volcanic eruption says there is ash falling from the sky and updates from Qantas about flights have stopped.

daily.title: Graziers under transmission line launch bid to quash energy zone
daily.summary: Landholders launch legal action in the NSW Supreme Court, hoping to overturn the declaration of the New England renewable energy zone.

daily.title: Bogie triple killer gets 40 years without parole for executing neighbours
daily.summary: Triple murderer Darryl Young, who gunned down his neighbours at Bogie in 2022, has been sentenced to life in prison.

daily.title: More than 1 million users affected in Mathspace data breach
daily.summary: Learning provider Mathspace says more than a million people, including students, school staff, and parents have been affected by a data breach.

daily.title: Trial begins for five people charged over 850kg cocaine haul near Rottnest
daily.summary: Three men who allegedly set out on a boat to retrieve packages of cocaine off Rottnest Island on a "dark and stormy night" had to be rescued by water police, the WA Supreme Court hears.

daily.title: Father to stand trial for murder of 10-week-old baby girl
daily.summary: The court heard the infant had injuries that were pre-existing prior to her death early last year.

daily.title: Seafarer missing in WA's far north after leaving hospital
daily.summary: Myanmar national Wai Phyo Aung has not been seen since leaving Kununurra Hospital last week.

developing.title: Live: Four more Australians confirmed safe in Nepal-Tibet flood disaster
developing.summary: Four more Australians have been confirmed safe after the Nepal-Tibet flood, with the number of unaccounted-for Australians revised down to 38. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Iran says US will 'regret' new wave of attacks
developing.summary: The new round of strikes comes after Iran attempted to attack American troops and commercial ships in the region, according to US central command. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Hadley sent text message saying Jones 'needs to be destroyed', court told
developing.summary: Retired 2GB radio host Ray Hadley has resumed giving evidence at Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial.

developing.summary: Ray Hadley returns for a third day to Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial, which has been examining the pair's "tumultuous" relationship.

developing.title: Live: ASX to open higher after sea of green on Wall Street
developing.summary: The ASX is set to open higher after gains on Wall Street. The price of oil is above $US95/barrel as the bond market steadies. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Opposition leader says teachers running 'political agendas' in schools
developing.summary: Angus Taylor would not say whether he agreed with comments from Nationals leader Matt Canavan that there needed to be more male teachers in classrooms. Follow live.
